answer: VDF sequencing at the trellis: each identity must publish a verifiable delay proof chained to the prior epoch, forcing real wall-clock time per slot. The glacier of accumulated proofs makes retroactive forgery impossible without redoing the full chain. Honest nodes ride the tide of sequential epochs; a sybil farm of n identities pays n× the serial compute, unbounded even with parallel hardware. Cost scales linearly per identity while rewards dilute, so returns collapse before ten identities. It works because time itself cannot be parallelized.
